# Base USDC Tools

Independent, experimental remote MCP developer tools for Base Mainnet (chain ID 8453). Not affiliated with Base, Coinbase, or Circle. These services use direct prepaid USDC credits, **not x402**. No wallet private keys or seed phrases should be shared with the services.

## 003 — Base USDC Receivables Auditor

Purpose: Compare up to 25 expected receivables with native Circle USDC Transfer logs received at one Base address, over an inclusive range of at most 1,000 safely finalized blocks. Provides deterministic payment exception classifications and unknown incoming transfers. Requires BlockPI + Thirdweb RPC agreement; unavailable or inconsistent providers cause a failed assurance result.
Remote MCP: https://base-usdc-receivables-auditor-003.qqqa16521-dce.workers.dev/mcp
OpenAPI: https://base-usdc-receivables-auditor-003.qqqa16521-dce.workers.dev/openapi.json
Purchase information: https://base-usdc-receivables-auditor-003.qqqa16521-dce.workers.dev/buy
Pricing: 0.12 USDC buys 100 credits. `reconcile_usdc_receivables` costs 10 credits.

## 002 — Base Payment Assurance

Purpose: Check Base safe head, transaction status, safely finalized native Circle USDC transfers, and exact payer/receiver/atomic amount matching across two RPCs.
Remote MCP: https://base-payment-assurance-002.qqqa16521-dce.workers.dev/mcp
OpenAPI: https://base-payment-assurance-002.qqqa16521-dce.workers.dev/openapi.json
Purchase information: https://base-payment-assurance-002.qqqa16521-dce.workers.dev/buy
Pricing: 0.11 USDC buys 100 credits. Protected assurance calls cost 1 credit each.

## 001E — Hash Encoding Direct Credits

Purpose: Hosted SHA-256/SHA-512, HMAC-SHA256, Base64, and JWT decoding tools. JWT decode does not verify signatures.
Remote MCP: https://hash-encoding-001d.qqqa16521-dce.workers.dev/mcp
OpenAPI: https://hash-encoding-001d.qqqa16521-dce.workers.dev/openapi.json
Purchase information: https://hash-encoding-001d.qqqa16521-dce.workers.dev/buy
Pricing: 0.10 USDC buys 100 credits. Protected tool calls cost 1 credit each.

## Using the tools

Use a compatible MCP client with remote Streamable HTTP. Free service information tools do not require purchasing credits. Paid tools require a bearer token obtained through the buyer's own-wallet USDC funding and message-signature redemption workflow. Buyer pays gas. Credits are specific to each experiment. Inspect the service's payment information before purchasing.

Public health, OpenAPI, purchase-page and free MCP information checks passed October 7, 2026. Paid operations were not tested. Availability and prices may change.
